headline: Shipt becomes the latest delivery app with an AI shopping assistant
context: Users can ask the assistant to do things like "Create a cart for my Saturday tailgate for 25 people and include some brunch items," or "Build a cart for easy school lunches and after-school snacks," Shipt says.
